Tom / Lydia —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Good to see alignment on the SellWith approach for the Redwood inference runtime. 2) Monica will update SKU map and share DocuSign for the sellwith addendum by Wed.
3) Karthik to circulate technical checklist and expected metering fields (we can demo mapping with a short runbook).

If that timeline looks good we’ll push a HubSpot deal and draft the Marketplace listing checklist this week.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the intake.

Best,

Tom / Lydia —

Quick technical note on the metering/export and packaging options so you can share with your engineers:

- Metering: we emit two correlated streams — event-level token usage (event_id, timestamp, model, tokens_in, tokens_out) and session-level aggregation (session_id, user_id_hash, start_ts, end_ts, total_tokens). For Marketplace SellWith we recommend mapping the session-level aggregation to a single usage SKU and sending hourly aggregates to the marketplace metering API.
- Sandbox exports: I’ve placed an anonymized 48-hour sample (redwood_metering_48h.csv) in the shared Drive and included a README explaining fields.
- Private offer packaging: we can publish as a managed SaaS listing or an AMI-backed private offer (AMI recommended if you need on-prem determinism). If choosing AMI, we’ll need a minimum lead time of 3 weeks for build/validation.

Jira ticket (intake): SUP-1234 — tracks the SellWith metering mapping and billing schema; I’ll post incremental updates there.

Link to sample & runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleSharedDrive
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-1234

-Karthik
